च: च The twentieth letter of the alphabet, and first of the second or palatial class of consonants, having the sound of Ch in church.

च mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) 1 Seedless. 2 Vile, base. m. (-चः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 The moon. 3 A thief. 4 A tortoise. ind. A particle and conjunction copulative or disjunctive, corresponding to 1 And. 2 Also. 3 Moreover. 4 Mutually. 5 Equally. 6 Otherwise. 7 For, on account of. 8 But, &c. 9 An expletive. E. चर to go, or चि to collect, &c. ड aff.
चक: चक r. 1st cl. (चकते) To repel, to resist. (चकति-ते) To be satiate or satisfied. 2 To shine.
चकास: चकास (ऋ) चकासृ r. 2nd cl. (चकास्ति) To shine.
चकासयत्: चकासयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Beautifying, illuminating. E. चकास to shine, causal form, शतृ aff.
चकासित: चकासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Illuminated, shining, splendid, beautiful. E. चकास, and क्त aff.
चकित: चकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Timid, fearful. 2 Frightened at, afraid of. n. (-तं) Timidity, groundless alarm. f. (-ता) A species of the Aṣṭi metre. E. चक to repel, affix क्त.
चकोर: चकोर m. (-रः) The bartavelle or Greek partridge, (Perdix rufa or Tetrao rufus.) E. चक to be satisfied, ओरन् Uṇādi affix; also with कन् added चकोरक; what is satisfied with the moonbeams, upon which the bird is fabulously said to subsist.
चकोरक: चकोरक m. (-कः) The Greek partridge: see the preceding.
चकोरदृश्: चकोरदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Fine-eyed. E. चकोर and दृश the eye.
चक्क: चक्क r. 10th cl. (चक्कयति) To give or inflict pain.
चक्नस: चक्नस m. (-सः) 1 Crookedness. 2 Dishonesty. E. क्नस to be crooked, अप् affix, and the root repeated.
चक्र: चक्र m. (-क्रः) 1 The ruddy or Brahmani goose, (Anas casarca.) n. (-क्रं) 1 An army, a host. 2 A realm, a region. 3 A multitude, a heap. 4 A wheel. 5 A potter's wheel. 6 An oil mill, &c. 7 A discus or sharp circular missile weapon. 8 A whirlpool. 9 A province, a number of villages, a district. 10 A form of military array, a circular position. 11 A diagram of various sorts for calculating nativities or foretelling events. 12 A ring, circle or depression of the body for mystical, astrological or cheiromantic purposes; six such are enumerated, or Mūlādhāra the parts about the pubis, above that is the Svādhiṣṭhānam or umbilical region, and above that the Maṇipūram or pit of the stomach or epigastrium, Anāhatam is the root of the nose, Viśuddham the hollow between the frontal sinuses, and the Ājñākhyam the fontenelle or union of the coronal and sagittal sutures; various faculties and divinities are supposed to be present in these hollows. 13 A cycle, a cycle of years. 14 (In Astronomy,) A sphere or circle, as राशिचक्रं the zodiac; प्राक् चक्रं an epicycle. 15 The horizon. 16 The spiral marks of the Śālagrāma or ammonite. E. कृ to do or make, with the reduplicate initial letter, affix क, or चक to repel, &c. with रक aff.
चक्रक: चक्रक m. (-कः) A logical form or proposition, arguing in a circle. E. कन् implying resemblance, added to the last.
चक्रकारक: चक्रकारक m. (-कः) A kind of perfume, apparently a dried shellfish: see नखी. E. चक्र a heap, and कारक what makes.
चक्रकुल्या: चक्रकुल्या f. (-ल्या) A species of fern, commonly Cākuliya, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.)
चक्रगण्डु: चक्रगण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) A round pillow. E. चक्र, and गण्डु a pillow.
चक्रगुच्छ: चक्रगुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A tree, (Jonesia asoca.) E. चक्र a wheel, and गुच्छ a cluster.
चक्रजीवक: चक्रजीवक m. (-कः) A potter. E. चक्र a wheel, and जीवक who lives by; also चक्रजीविन.
चक्रदंष्ट्र: चक्रदंष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A hog. E. चक्र, and दंष्ट्र a tusk, having a curved tusk.
चक्रधर: चक्रधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having a wheel, &c. m. (-रः) 1 A village or common tumbler or juggler. 2 One who holds a wheel, a discus, &c. 3 The manager or owner of many villages. 4 A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA, who is represented as holding a discus in one hand. 5 A snake. E. चक्र a wheel, &c. and धर who holds.
चक्रनामन्: चक्रनामन् m. (-मा) A pyritic ore of iron: see माक्षिक. E. चक्र a wheel, &c. and नामन् appellation.
चक्रपद्माट: चक्रपद्माट m. (-टः) Cassia tora: see चक्रमर्द्दक. E. चक्र a wheel, पद्म a lotus, and अट what goes or is.
चक्रपर्णी: चक्रपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant commonly Cākuliya, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.) E. चक्र a wheel, and पर्ण a leaf, the leaves being nearly round.
चक्रपाणि: चक्रपाणि m. (-णिः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. चक्र, and पाणि the hand, being always represented with a discus in one hand.
चक्रपाद: चक्रपाद m. (-दः) 1 A carriage. 2 An elephant. E. चक्र a wheel, and पाद a foot; also चक्रपादक.
चक्रपाल: चक्रपाल m. (-लः) 1 Superintendent of a province. 2 One who carries a discus. 3 A circle. 4 The horizon. E. चक्र, and पाल who or what protects.
चक्रफल: चक्रफल n. (-लं) A missile weapon, a kind of discus. E. चक्र, and फल fruit, bearing a discus as it were for fruit.
चक्रबान्धव: चक्रबान्धव m. (-वः) The sun. E. चक्र the ruddy goose, and बान्धव a friend; these birds being supposed to couple only in the day time.
चक्रभृत्: चक्रभृत् m. (-भृत्) A name of VIṢṆU. E. चक्र a discus, and भृत् who cherishes: see चक्रपाणि, &c.
चक्रभेदिनी: चक्रभेदिनी f. (-नी) Night. E. चक्र the ruddy goose, and भेदिनी what divides, (male and female;) these birds being condemned, according to the Hindus, to be separated at night.
चक्रमण्डलिन्: चक्रमण्डलिन् m. (-ली) A large snake, (Boa constrictor.) E. चक्र a wheel, and मण्डल a circumference, implying either that the body of the snake, or the spots on the body may be compared to a wheel.
चक्रमर्द: चक्रमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) Cassia tora. E. चक्र a wheel, here meaning figuratively a large leprous spot, and मर्द्दं what cleanses or removes, from मृद with अच् added; or with वुन् affix चक्रमर्द्दक.
चक्रमर्द्द: चक्रमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) Cassia tora. E. चक्र a wheel, here meaning figuratively a large leprous spot, and मर्द्दं what cleanses or removes, from मृद with अच् added; or with वुन् affix चक्रमर्द्दक.
चक्रमुख: चक्रमुख m. (-खः) A hog. E. चक्र a discus, and मुख face; cutting the ground as it were with a sharp weapon.
चक्रयान: चक्रयान n. (-नं) Any wheel carriage. E. क्षक्र a wheel, and यान a carriage.
चक्ररद: चक्ररद m. (-दः) A hog, a boar. E. चक्र, and रद a tooth or tusk: see चक्रमुख.
चक्रलक्षणा: चक्रलक्षणा f. (-णा) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum:) see गुडूची.
चक्रला: चक्रला f. (-ला) A plant, (Kyllinga monocephala.) E. चक्र a wheel, and ल what gets.
चक्रवत्: चक्रवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Circular, being in a ring or circle. 2 Armed with a discus. 3 Wheeled, &c. m. (-वान्) 1 The proprietor of an oil mill, or any one in which seeds are bruised. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 An emperor. E. चक्र a wheel, &c. मतुप् poss. aff.
चक्रवत् ind. In rotation, going round or revolving like a wheel. E. चक्र, and वति aff.
चक्रवर्तिन्: चक्रवर्त्तिन् m. (-र्त्ती) An emperor, a sovereign of the world, the ruler of a Cakra or country described as extending from sea to sea; twelve princes beginning with Bharata are especially considered as Cakravartīs. E. चक्र a reign, and वृत to abide, affix इनि.
चक्रवर्त्तिन्: चक्रवर्त्तिन् m. (-र्त्ती) An emperor, a sovereign of the world, the ruler of a Cakra or country described as extending from sea to sea; twelve princes beginning with Bharata are especially considered as Cakravartīs. E. चक्र a reign, and वृत to abide, affix इनि.
चक्रवर्तिनी: चक्रवर्त्तिनी f. (-नी) A fragrant plant, commonly Cakāvat. E. चक्र a heap, and वर्त्तिन् what abides or grows, fem. affix ङीष्.
चक्रवर्त्तिनी: चक्रवर्त्तिनी f. (-नी) A fragrant plant, commonly Cakāvat. E. चक्र a heap, and वर्त्तिन् what abides or grows, fem. affix ङीष्.
चक्रवाक: चक्रवाक m. (-कः) The ruddy goose, commonly called in India, the Brahmany duck or goose, (Anas casarca.) E. चक्र an imitative sound, and वाक speech.
चक्रवाट: चक्रवाट m. (-टः) 1 Limit, boundary. 2 A lamp stand. 3 Engaging in any action. E. चक्र, and वट to surround, affix घञ्.
चक्रवात: चक्रवात m. (-तः) A whirlwind, a hurricane. E. चक्र a circle, and वात wind.
चक्रवाल: चक्रवाल m. (-लः) A range of mountains supposed to encircle the earth, and to be the limit of light and darkness. n. (-लं) The sensible horizon. E. चक्र a region, वल to encompass, and अण् affix; girding the world; or वाड to emerge, &c. affix अच्, what emerges (from darkness), in the shape of a wheel; ड changed to ल; also चक्रवाड.
चक्रव्यूह: चक्रव्यूह m. (-हः) The circular array of troops. E. चक्र and व्यूह array.
चक्रवृद्धि: चक्रवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Compound interest. E. चक्र a wheel, वृद्धि increase.
चक्रश्रेणी: चक्रश्रेणी f. (-णी) A plant bearing a crooked fruit: see अजशृङ्गी. E. चक्र a wheel, and श्रेणी a line or row.
चक्रसंज्ञ: चक्रसंज्ञ n. (-ज्ञं) Tin. E. चक्र, and सज्ञा a name.
चक्रसम्बर: चक्रसम्बर m. (-रः) The name of a Bauddha deity; also हेरम्ब. E. चक्र a discus, and सम्बर who holds.
चक्रहस्त: चक्रहस्त m. (-स्तः) VIṢṆU. E. चक्र, and हस्त hand: holding a discus.
चक्राङ्की: चक्राङ्की f. (-ङ्की) A wild goose. E. चक्र a number, and अकि to go, affixes अच् and ङीप्, flying in large flocks.
चक्राङ्ग: चक्राङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A gander. 2 A carriage. f. (-ङ्गी) 1 A goose. 2 A drug: see कटुकि. 3 A potherb, (Hilancha repens:) see हिलमोचिका. E. चक्र a wheel, &c. and अङ्ग a limb or the body.
चक्राट: चक्राट m. (-टः) 1 A juggler, a snake-catcher, one who exhibits snakes and pretends to cure their bites. 2 A knave, a cheat, a rogue. 3 A gold coin or certain weight of gold, a Dīnāra. E. चक्र a number of villages, and अट who goes, i. e. a vagabond, &c.
चक्राण: चक्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Doing. 2 Done. E. कृ to do, कानच् aff.
चक्राधिवासिन्: चक्राधिवासिन् m. (-सी) The orange tree. E. चक्र a heap, and अधिवस to abide, णिनि aff.
चक्रावर्त: चक्रावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) Turning round, whirling or rotatory motion. E. चक्र a wheel, and आवर्त्त revolving.
चक्रावर्त्त: चक्रावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) Turning round, whirling or rotatory motion. E. चक्र a wheel, and आवर्त्त revolving.
चक्रि: चक्रि m. (-क्रिः) An agent, a maker, a doer. E. कृ to do, कि affix, the root reduplicate and the deriv. irr.
चक्रिन्: चक्रिन् mfn. (-क्री-क्रिणी-क्रि) 1 Having or holding a discus, &c. 2 Wheeled, having a wheel. 3 Circular. m. (-क्री) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 A potter. 3 The ruddy goose. 4 A snake. 5 An informer. 6 A tumbler, one who exhibits tricks with a discus or a wheel. 7 An oil grinder. 8 An emperor, a Cakravartī: see चक्रवर्त्तिन्. 9 One who rides in a carriage. 10 A crow. 11 An ass. 12 Cassia, (the tree.) E. चक्र a wheel, &c. and इनि poss. aff.
चक्रीवत्: चक्रीवत् m. (-वान्) 1 An ass. 2 The name of a king. E. चक्र a wheel, वतु affix, and deriv. irr. rolling over like a wheel.
चक्रु: चक्रु m. (-क्रुः) An agent, a maker, a doer. E. कृ to make or do, with the reduplicate initial, and कु Uṇādi aff.
चक्रेश्वरी: चक्रेश्वरी f. (-री) A female deity peculiar to the Jainas, one of their Vidyā Devis or goddesses of wisdom. E. चक्र the universe, and ईश्वरी mistress.
चक्ष: चक्ष (इङ्) चक्षिङ् r. 2nd cl. (चष्टे) 1 To speak, to tell. 2 To see; (in this sense आङ् is usually prefixed) 3 To eat. ख्या or क्श are substituted for the radical letters in several tenses of this verb.
चक्षण: चक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Eating a relish to promote drinking. 2 Speaking, saying. E. चक्ष to speak, to eat, affix ल्युट्.
चक्षस्: चक्षस् m. (-क्षाः) 1 A name of VṚHASPATI the preceptor of the gods. 2 A spiritual teacher, an instructor in sacred science. E. चक्ष to speak, affix असुन्.
चक्षुःश्रवस्: चक्षुःश्रवस् m. (-वाः) A snake. E. चक्षुस् an eye, and श्रवस् an ear; whose eyes are ears.
चक्षुर्दान: चक्षुर्दान n. (-नं) The ceremony of anointing the eyes of the image at the time of consecration. E. चक्षुस्, and दान giving.
चक्षुर्विषय: चक्षुर्विषय m. (-यः-यं) 1 Presence, sight. 2 An object of sight, any visible object. 3 Visibility. E. चक्षुस्, and विषय object.
चक्षुष्मान्: चक्षुष्मान् mfn. (-ष्मान्-ष्मन्ती-ष्मत्) 1 Having eyes, seeing. 2 Having fine eyes. E. चक्षुस्, and मतुप् aff.
चक्षुष्य: चक्षुष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) 1 Beautiful, pleasing or well looking. 2 Fit or agreeable for the eyes. m. (-ष्यः) 1 A flower, (Pandanus odoratissimus.) 2 A plant: see पुण्डराक. 3 A collyrium or application to the eyes, extracted from the Amomum anthorhiza. f. (-ष्या) 1 A blue stone, or according to some, the calx of brass used as collyrium. 2 A pleasing or interesting woman. E. चक्षुस् the eye, affix यत्.
चक्षुस्: चक्षुस् n. (-क्षुः) The eye. E. चक्ष to speak, and उसि aff.
चक्षूरोग: चक्षूरोग m. (-गः) Ophthalmia. E. चक्षुस्, and रोग disease.
चघ: चघ r. 5th cl. (चघ्नोति) To smite or slay.
चङ्कुर: चङ्कुर m. (-रः) 1 A car, a carriage. 2 A tree. n. (-रं) Any vehicle. E. चकि a sautra root, to wonder, and उरच् Uṇādi aff.
चङ्क्रमण: चङ्क्रमण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Who or what goes slowly or crookedly. n. (-णं) Going, proceeding, going tortuously or slowly. E. क्रम to go, युच् affix, and the root reiterated.
चङ्क्रमा: चङ्क्रमा f. (-मा) Going tortuously or slowly. E. क्रम to go, root repeated, अङ् and टाप् aff.
चङ्क्रमावत्: चङ्क्रमावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Who or what moves slowly or crookedly. E. चङ्क्रमा, and मतुप् aff.
चङ्ग: चङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 Handsome, beautiful. 2 Dexterous, clever. 3 Sound, healthy. E. चं the moon, and ग what goes; what resembles the moon in beauty, &c.
चचेण्डा: चचेण्डा f. (-ण्डा) A creeper, commonly Cicirā.
चञ्च: चञ्च (उ) चञ्चु r. 1st cl. (चञ्चति) To go, to move.
चञ्चत्: चञ्चत् mfn. (-ञ्चन्-ञ्चन्ती-ञ्चत्) 1 Going, moving. 2 Unsteady, shaking. E. चञ्च to go, शतृ aff.
चञ्चत्क: चञ्चत्क mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं) Trembling, moving. E. क्षञ्चत् the present participle of चञ्च as above, affix कन्.
चञ्चरीक: चञ्चरीक m. (-कः) A large black bee. E. चर to go, reduplicated, नुम् inserted, ईकन् Uṇādi aff.
चञ्चल: चञ्चल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Trembling, shaking, moving, unsteady. 2 Fickle, inconsiderate, inconstant, (unsteady, metaphorically.) m. (-लः) 1 The wind. 2 A lecher, a libertine, a lover. f. (-ला) 1 Lightning. 2 LAKṢMĪ or the goddess of fortune. 3 Longpepper. E. चल to go, in the reiterative form, नुम् inserted.
चञ्चलत्व: चञ्चलत्व n. (-त्वं) Fickleness, inconstancy, unsteadiness. E. चञ्चल, and त्व affix; also with तल् affix चञ्चलता.
चञ्चलहृदय: चञ्चलहृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Capricious, fickle, false hearted. E. चञ्चल, and हृदय the heart.
चञ्चा: चञ्चा f. (-च्चा) 1 A mat, a stool, &c. made of reeds or basket work. 2 A puppet of grass or reeds, a man of straw. E. चञ्च to go, अच् aff.
चञ्चु: चञ्चु f. (-ञ्चुः) A beak; also चञ्च. m. (-ञ्चुः) 1 The castor oil plant. 2 A kind of potherb. 3 A deer. E. चञ्चु to go, to eat, affix उ.
चञ्चुका: चञ्चुका f. (-का) A beak. E. कन् added to the preceding.
चञ्चुभृत्: चञ्चुभृत् m. (-भृत्) A bird. E. चञ्चु a beak, and भृत् who possesses; also other similar compounds as चञ्चुमत्, &c.
चञ्चुमत्: चञ्चुमत् mf. (-मान्-मती) A bird. E. चञ्चु a beak, and मतुप् poss. aff.
चञ्चुर: चञ्चुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Expert in, conversant with. 2 Going to repeatedly. E. चर to go, intensitive form, अच् aff.
चञ्चुसूचि: चञ्चुसूचि m. (-चिः) The tailor bird, (Sylvia sutoria.) E. चञ्चु a beak, and सूचि a needle; having a sharp-pointed beak; also with कन् added, चञ्चुसूचिक
चञ्चू: चञ्चू f. (-ञ्चूः) A beak: see चञ्चु, the affix being ऊ.
चञ्चूर्यमाण: चञ्चूर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Following evil practices, behaving ill, addicted to wickedness. E. चर to go, intensitive form, शानच् aff.
चञ्चूर्य्यमाण: चञ्चूर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Following evil practices, behaving ill, addicted to wickedness. E. चर to go, intensitive form, शानच् aff.
चट: चट r. 1st and 10th cl. (चटति चाटषति) 1 To break, to pierce 2 To kill, to injure.
चटक: चटक m. (-कः) A sparrow. f. (-का) 1 A hen-sparrow. 2 A young hen-sparrow. 3 The root of long pepper: see चटकाशिरस and चटिका. E. चट to break, वुन् affix; breaking corn, &c.
चटकाशिरस्: चटकाशिरस् n. (-रः) The root of long pepper: see चटिकाशिरस्; also mas. चटकाशिर (-राः).
चटिका: चटिका f. (-का) 1 The root of long pepper. 2 A sparrow: see चटका, &c.
चटिकाशिरस्: चटिकाशिरस् mn. (-राः-रः) The root of long pepper. E. चटका a sparrow, and शिरस् a head; resembling in colour the head of a sparrow; in other forms चटका, चटिका, शिरस् and चटकाशिरस्, &c.
चटु: चटु mn. (-टुः-टु) 1 Scream, screech. 2 Kind or agreeable discourse. m. (-टुः) 1 The belly. 2 A posture of devotion amongst ascetics. E. चट to break, &c. Uṇādi affix उ; also चाटु.
चटुल: चटुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Tremulous, trembling. 2 Shaking, moving. 3 Beautiful. f. (-ला) Lightning. E. चट to hurt, to break, and उलच् Uṇādi aff.
चटुलालस: चटुलालस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Pleased with or desirous of flattery. E. चटु, and लालस desirous.
चटुलोल: चटुलोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Tremulous and beautiful, beautiful as a soft swimming eye, &c. E. चटु beautiful, and लोल shaking, trembling.
चड: चड (इ,) चडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (चण्डते and चण्डति, चण्डयति) To be angry, to be wrathful or passionate.
चण: चण r. 1st cl. (चणति) 1 To give. 2 To sound. 3 To hurt or kill.
चणक: चणक m. (-कः) 1 Chick-pea, (Cicer arietinum.) 2 The name of a sage. f. (-का) Linseed. E. चण to be given, affix अच् and कन् added; what is given to horses, &c.
चणकात्मज: चणकात्मज m. (-जः) The name of a sage; also called VĀTSYĀYANA. E. चणक, and आत्मज born; the son of CAṆAKA.
चणकाम्लक: चणकाम्लक n. (-कं) Pease with salt. E. चणक, and अम्ल acid.
चणकाम्लवार्: चणकाम्लवार् n. (-र्) Water drops on the leaves of the Cicer. E. चणकाम्ल, and बार् water.
चण्ड: चण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) 1 Fierce, violent, passionate. 2 Hot, warm. 2 Pungent, acrid. m. (-ण्डः) 1 The tamarind tree. 2 A messenger of YAMA. 3 A Daitya, a demon. f. (-ण्डा) 1 A perfume, commonly Cor. 2 A kind of grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.) 3 The name of a river in the east of Bengal. 4 A goddess peculiar to the Jainas. f. (-ण्डा-ण्डी) A name of the goddess DURGĀ, applied especially to her incarnation for the purpose of destroying Mahiṣāsura; this exploit forms the subject of a section of the Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa, and is particularly celebrated in Bengal at the Durgā Pūja, or festival held in honour of the goddess, towards the close of the year, (Oct.-Nov.) (-ण्डी) 1 A passionate woman. 2 A mischievous or furious woman. 3 A species of the Atijagatī verse. n. (-ण्डं) 1 Heat, warmth. 2 Passion, wrath. E. चडि to be wrathful, ड Uṇādi affix, and टा or ङीप् affixes of the feminine gender.
चण्डता: चण्डता f. (-ता) 1 Warmth, pungency. 2 Warmth of temper, passionateness. E. चण्ड angry, and तल् abstract affix; also with त्व, चण्डत्वं.
चण्डनायिका: चण्डनायिका f. (-का) 1 The goddess DURGĀ. 2 One of the eight Nāyikās. E. चण्ड a demon, and नायिका mistress.
चण्डरुद्रिका: चण्डरुद्रिका f. (-का) Knowledge of mystical nature, acquired by worship of the Nāyikās. E. चण्ड, and रुद्र ŚIVA, वुन् aff.
चण्डवत्: चण्डवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Passionate, violent, warm. f. (-ती) 1 A name or form of DURGĀ. 2 One of her attendants. E. चण्ड anger, and मतुप् poss. aff.
चण्डात: चण्डात m. (-तः) A fragrant plant, (Nerium odorum;) also प्रतीहास. E. चण्ड heat, and अत to go or be, affix अण्.
चण्डातक: चण्डातक mn. (-कः-कं) A short petticoat. E. चण्डा an angry woman, अत to go, and वुन् affix; it being described as the garb of women of some consequence, and therefore privileged to give themselves airs.
चण्डाल: चण्डाल m. (-लः) An outcaste, a Cāṇḍāla, the generic name for a man of the lowest of the mixed tribes, born from a Śūdra father and Brahman mother. E. चण्ड angry, and अल able, or चण्ड to be angry, and आलञ् Uṇādi affix; proper to execute all vile or barbarous acts; also चाण्डाल.
चण्डालवल्लकी: चण्डालवल्लकी f. (-की) A common or vulgar lute. E. चण्डाल an outcaste, and वल्लकी a lute.
चण्डालिका: चण्डालिका f. (-का) 1 A common lute. 2 A name of the goddess DURGĀ. 3 A plant. E. चण्डाल, and इकन् affix; or चण्ड a demon, &c. आली a line or troop, and कन् affix; hence also चण्डालीका.
चण्डांशु: चण्डांशु m. (-शुः) The sun. E. चण्ड hot, अंशु ray.
चण्डिका: चण्डिका f. (-का) The goddess DURGĀ. E. कण् added to चण्डी q. v. also चण्डा and चण्डी.
चण्डिल: चण्डिल m. (-लः) 1 A barber. 2 A name of ŚIVA. 3 A kind of potherb: see बास्तूक. f. (-ला) The name of a river. E. चडि to be wrathful, or to cause wrath, and इलच् Uṇādi aff.
चण्डीकुसुम: चण्डीकुसुम m. (-मः) Red oleander. E. चण्डी, and कुसुम a flower.
चण्डु: चण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) 1 A rat. 2 A small monkey, (Simia erythroea.) E. चडि to be passionate, उ aff.
चत: चत (ए) चते r. 1st cl. (चतति-ते) To ask, to beg, to solicit.
चतु: चतुः ind. Four times: see चतुर्.
चतुः: चतुः ind. Four times: see चतुर्.
चतुःशाल: चतुःशाल nf. (-लं-ला) A square formed by four houses. E. चतुर् four, शाला a hall or house: the compound takes the neuter gender or the feminine, with टाप् affix; also with कन् added चतुःशालक.
चतुःषष्टि: चतुःषष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 The number sixty-four. 2 The Rig Veda. 3 Art or science collectively, supposed to comprise sixty-four branches. E. चतुर् four, and षष्टि sixty; before ष, र becomes Visarga.
चतुर्: चतुर् mfn. plu. only, (चत्वारः चतस्र चत्वारि) Four: in composition, and the last member of a compound, the numeral is inflected in all the numbers; thus प्रियचतुर् Who has four favorites, makes masc. and fem. (sing.) प्रियचत्वा (du.) त्वारौ (plu.) त्वारः and n. (sing.) प्रियचतुः (du.) चत्वारी (plu.) चत्वारि, &c.
चतुर: चतुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Dexterous, ingenious, clever. 2 Visible, perceptible. m. (-रः) 1 A round pillow, one for the cheek. 3 An elephant stable. E. चत to ask, Uṇādi affix उरच्.
चतुरङ्ग: चतुरङ्ग n. (-ङ्गः) 1 An entire army, comprising elephants, cars, horse and foot. 2 A sort of chess. E. चतुर्, and अङ्ग a member.
चतुरङ्गवल: चतुरङ्गवल n. (-लं) An entire army: see the last. E. चतुरङ्ग, and बल an army.
चतुरङ्गसैन्य: चतुरङ्गसैन्य n. (-न्यं) An entire army: see चतुरङ्ग. E. चतुरङ्ग, and सैन्य an army.
चतुरङ्गिन्: चतुरङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) Having four parts or members. f. (-ङ्गिनी) An army. E. चतुरङ्ग, and इनि aff.
चतुरङ्गुल: चतुरङ्गुल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Four fingers, (long, &c.) m. (लः) A kind of Cassia, (Cassia fistula.) E. चतुर् four, and अङ्गुली a finger; the leaves being four fingers in length.
चतुरस्र: चतुरस्र mfn. (-स्रः-स्रा-स्रं) Four cornered, quadrangular. n. (-स्रं) A square. E. चतुर् four, and अस्र a corner.
चतुरानन: चतुरानन m. (-नः) A name of BRAHMĀ. E. चतुर् four, and आनन face; fourfaced.
चतुर्गति: चतुर्गति m. (-तिः) A tortoise. E. चतुर four (feet), and गति motion; a quadruped.
चतुर्गुण: चतुर्गुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Four times, four-fold. E. चतुर्, and गुण multiplication.
चतुर्थ: चतुर्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था or -र्थी-र्थं) Fourth. f. (-र्थी) The fourth lunation. E. चतुर् four, थुक् aff.
चतुर्थकाल: चतुर्थकाल n. (-लं) The fourth season, implying especially the evening of every second day of a person's fasting. E. चतुर्थ, and काल time.
चतुर्थफल: चतुर्थफल n. (-लं) (In Astronomy,) The second inequality or equation of a planet. E. चतुर्थ, and फल quotient.
चतुर्थांश: चतुर्थांश m. (-शः) A quarter, a fourth part. E. चतुर्थ, and अंश part.
चतुर्थिका: चतुर्थिका f. (-का) A Pala. E. कन् fem. form added to चतुर्थ.
चतुर्दत्: चतुर्दत् mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्) Four toothed. E. चतुर four, दतृ substituted for दन्त a tooth.
चतुर्दन्त: चतुर्दन्त m. (-न्तः) INDRA'S elephant. E. चतुर four, and दन्त a tooth.
चतुर्दश: चतुर्दश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Fourteen. f. (-शी) The fourteenth lunation. E. चतुर्दश, and टच् aff.
चतुर्दशन्: चतुर्द्दशन् mfn. plur. (-दश) Fourteen. E. चतुर, and दशन् ten.
चतुर्द्दशन्: चतुर्द्दशन् mfn. plur. (-दश) Fourteen. E. चतुर, and दशन् ten.
चतुर्दोल: चतुर्द्दोल n. (-लं) A royal litter. E. चतुर four, (supporters,) दोल a swing.
चतुर्द्दोल: चतुर्द्दोल n. (-लं) A royal litter. E. चतुर four, (supporters,) दोल a swing.
चतुर्द्धा: चतुर्द्धा ind. Four times, four-fold. E. चतुर, and घा aff.
चतुर्भद्र: चतुर्भद्र n. (-द्रं) The aggregate of four objects of human wishes, viz. virtue, love, wealth, and final beatitude. E. चतुर four, and भद्र fortunate, auspicious: see चतुर्व्वर्ग.
चतुर्भाग: चतुर्भाग m. (-गः) Fourth part. E. चतुर्, and भाग a share.
चतुर्भुज: चतुर्भुज m. (-जः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 An equilateral tetragon. E. चतुर् four, and भुज an arm.
चतुर्मुख: चतुर्म्मुख m. (-खः) 1 The deity BRAHMĀ. 2 A preparation of mercury. E. चतुर्, and मुख a face.
चतुर्म्मुख: चतुर्म्मुख m. (-खः) 1 The deity BRAHMĀ. 2 A preparation of mercury. E. चतुर्, and मुख a face.
चतुर्युग: चतुर्युग n. (-गं) The aggregate of the four Yugas or ages of the Hindus, a Mahāyuga or 4,320,000 years. E. चतुर् four, and युग an age.
चतुर्वक्त्र: चतुर्वक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) A name of BRAHMĀ. E. चतुर् four, and वक्त्र a face: see चतुर्मुख and other synonymous compounds.
चतुर्वर्ग: चतुर्वर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 The four objects of human pursuit collectively: see चतुर्भद्र. 2 Any assemblage of four things. E. चतुर् four, and वर्ग class.
चतुर्वर्ण: चतुर्वर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 The four classes of Hindus. 2 Four principal colours. 3 Four letters. E. चतुर्, and वर्ण tribe.
चतुर्विद्य: चतुर्विद्य m. (-द्यः) A priest who has studied the four Vedas. E. चतुर् four, विद्या knowledge; also चतुर्वेद, and with अण् added चातुर्वेद्य and चातुर्वैद.
चतुर्विध: चतुर्विध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Of four sorts or kinds, in four ways. E. चतुर्, and विध kind.
चतुश्शाला: चतुश्शाला f. (-ला) A square of four houses, or a court inclosed by four buildings. E. चतुर्, and शाला a hall.
चतुष्क: चतुष्क mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं) Four. f. (-ष्की) 1 A large four-sided pond or tank. 2 A bed or musquito curtain. 3 A necklace of four strings. E. चतुर् four, कन् affix, and र is changed to ष.
चतुष्कोण: चतुष्कोण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Square, quadrangular. m. (-णः) A square, a tetragon. E. चतुर्, and कोण a corner.
चतुष्टय: चतुष्टय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Four. 2 Four-fold. n. (-यं) 1 A square. 2 The centre of a circle. 3 The aggregate of four. E. चतुर, and तयट् aff.
चतुष्पथ: चतुष्पथ m. (-थः) A Brahman. n. (-थं) A place where four roads meet. E. चतुर् four, and पथि a road, अ aff.
चतुष्पद: चतुष्पद nf. (-दं-दी) Verse, a metre of stanzas especially consisting of four Padas or lines. m. (-दः) An animal with four legs, a quadruped. E. चतुर् four, and पद for पाद a foot; also read चतुष्पाद.
चतुष्पाटी: चतुष्पाटी f. (-टी) A river. E. चतुर् four (the four quarters), and पाटी what goes.
चतुष्पाठी: चतुष्पाठी f. (-ठी) A school for Brahmans. E. चतुर् four, (the Vedas,) पाठ perusal.
चतुष्पाणि: चतुष्पाणि m. (-णिः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. चतुर् four, and पाणि a hand; the four-handed.
चतुष्पाद्: चतुष्पाद् mfn. (-पात्) 1 A quadruped. 2 A whole of four parts or quarters. 2 A judicial procedure, consisting of four processes, plea, defence, rejoinder, and sentence. E. चतुर्, and पाद् a foot.
चतुस्सम: चतुस्सम n. (-मं) An unguent of four ingredients, Sandal, agallochum, saffron, and musk. E. चतुर् four, and सम equal, same.
चतुस्रिंशज्जातकज्ञ: चतुस्रिंशज्जातकज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A Buddha, a Bauddha saint. E. चतुस्रिंशत् thirty-four, जातक species, and ज्ञ who knows.
चत्वर: चत्वर n. (-रं) 1 A levelled spot of ground prepared for a sacrifice. 2 A court yard. E. चत to ask, Uṇādi affix वरच्.
चत्वाल: चत्वाल m. (-लः) 1 A hole in the ground, &c. prepared for oblation with fire. 2 The womb. 3 Kusa grass. E. चत to ask, वालच् affix, or with वालञ् affix, चात्वल.
चद: चद r. 1st cl. (ए) चदे (चदति-ते) To ask or beg, to solicit. (इ) चदि (चंदति) 1 To gladden. 2 To shine.
चदिर: चदिर m. (-रः) 1 An elephant. 2 The moon. 3 Camphor. 4 A snake. E. चद to shine, किरच् Uṇādi aff.
चन: चन r. 1st and 10th cls. (चनति चानयति) To hurt, to injure in any manner, to wound or kill, &c. 2 To believe, to confide. 3 To make a sound.
चन ind. A particle affixed to certain words, giving them an indefinite signification, as कदा when, कदाचन some when, at sometime, कः who कञ्चन some one: see चित्. E. चन to sound, affix अच्.
चनस्: चनस् n. (-नः) Food. E. च, असुन् Uṇādi affix, and नुट् augment.
चन्द: चन्द m. (-न्दः) The moon. E. चदि to shine, affix अच्: see चन्द्र.
चन्दक: चन्दक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Pleasing, joy-inspiring. m. (-कः) 1 The moon. 2 Moonlight. 3 A small silvery fish, of a genus allied to the Zeus, (Canda, HAM.) E. चदि to shine, वुन् aff.
चन्दकपुष्प: चन्दकपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Cloves. E. चन्द्रक, and पुष्प flower.
चन्दन: चन्दन mn. (-नः-नं) Sandal, (Sirium myrtifolium;) it implies either the tree, the wood, or the unctuous preparations of the wood, held in high estimation as perfumes. n. (-नं) Red Sandal wood: see रक्रचन्दन. m. (-नः) A kind of ape. f. (-नी) The name of a river. E. चदि to gladden, to delight, affix ल्युट्.
चन्दनाचल: चन्दनाचल m. (-लः) The Malaya mountain, part of the southern range of the Ghāts, where Sandal wood is procured. E. चन्दन and अचल a hill, the Sandal hill; also similar names, as चन्दनाद्रि, चन्दनपर्वत, &c.
चन्दिर: चन्दिर m. (-रः) 1 An elephant. 2 The moon. E. चदि to shine, &c. Uṇādi affix किरच्.
चन्द्र: चन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 The moon considered as a planet or a deity. 2 Camphor. 3 Water. 4 Gold. 5 A plant, (Crinum:) see रोचनी. 6 (In composition) Pre-eminent, (as पुरुषचन्द्र an eminent man, a chief, a moon of men.) 7 The eye in the peacock's tail. 8 One of the eighteen minor Dvīpas or divisions of the known continent. 9 The mark of the soft aspirate. 10 A pearl with a red tinge. 11 Any thing giving pleasure. f. (-न्द्रा) 1 An awning, a canopy. 2 Small cardamoms: see एला. E. चदि to shine, Uṇādi affix रक्.
चन्द्रक: चन्द्रक m. (-कः) 1 The moon. 2 A ring, a circle, (like the moon.) 3 The eye in a peacock's tail. 4 A finger nail. 5 A fish, (Canda, HAM.) n. (-कं) Black pepper. E. चन्द्र the moon, and कन् affix of resemblance.
चन्द्रकवत्: चन्द्रकवत् m. (-वान्) A peacock. E. चन्द्रक the mark in his tail, मतुप् aff.
चन्द्रकला: चन्द्रकला f. (-ला) 1 A digit, or one-sixteenth of the moon's orb; each is personified as a female divinity, and worshipped in some Tāntrika ceremonies. 2 A small drum. 3 A fish commonly called Vacā or Bacā, (Pimelodus vacha, HAM.) E. चन्द्र the moon, and कला a digit.
चन्द्रकान्त: चन्द्रकान्त m. (-न्तः) A fabulous gem, the moon-stone, supposed to be formed of the congelation of the rays of the moon; a kind of crystal may perhaps be meant. mn. (-न्तः-न्तं) 1 Sandal. 2 The white water lily. f. (-न्ता) 1 Night. 2 The wife of the moon. E. चन्द्र the moon, and कान्त splendid or beloved.
चन्द्रकिन्: चन्द्रकिन् m. (-की) A peacock. E. चन्द्रक the eye of the peacock's tail, and इनि poss. aff.
चन्द्रगुप्त: चन्द्रगुप्त m. (-प्तः) 1 The registrar of YAMA'S court. 2 SANDROKOPTUS king of Pāṭaliputra.
चन्द्रगोल: चन्द्रगोल n. (-लं) The orb or sphere of the moon. E. चन्द्र, and गोल a ball.
चन्द्रगोलस्थ: चन्द्रगोलस्थ m. (-स्थः) A deceased and deified progenitor. E. चन्द्रगोल, and स्थ who stays or abides; an inhabitant of the lunar sphere.
चन्द्रगोलिका: चन्द्रगोलिका f. (-का) Moonlight. E. चन्द्रगोल the lunar orb, and कन् affix; derived from the moon.
चन्द्रचञ्चल: चन्द्रचञ्चल mf. (-लः-ला) A small fish, (Canda, HAM.) E. चन्द्र, and चञ्चल trembling, quivering, and glistering like the moon.
चन्द्रदार: चन्द्रदार plu. m. (-राः) The twenty-seven lunar mansions, which, in mythology, are so many nymphs, daughters of DAKṢA, and wedded to CANDRA, or the moon. E. चन्द्र, and दार a wife.
चन्द्रनिभ: चन्द्रनिभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Like the moon, bright, handsome. E. चन्द्र, and निभ what resembles.
चन्द्रभागा: चन्द्रभागा f. (-गा-गी) The name of a river, the Chinab, one of the five streams of the Punjab. E. चन्द्रभाग the name of a mountain, part of the Himāla range, where the river is said to have its source, affix of derivation अण्, hence also it may be read चान्द्रभागा-गी.
चन्द्रप्रभ: चन्द्रप्रभ m. (-भः) The eighth Jina or Jaina pontiff. f. (-भा) 1 Moonlight. 2 A compound of various drugs used in jaundice, piles, &c. E. चन्द्र, and प्रभा light.
चन्द्रमणि: चन्द्रमणि m. (-णिः) The Candrakānta or moon-gem: see चन्द्रकान्त. E. चन्द्र the moon, and मणि a gem.
चन्द्रमण्डल: चन्द्रमण्डल n. (-लं) The orb or disc of the moon, the lunar sphere. E. चन्द्र, and मण्डल circle.
चन्द्रमस्: चन्द्रमस् m. (-माः) The moon. E. चन्द्र camphor, मा to mete or measure, and असि Uṇādi affix; rendering all objects white like camphor.
चन्द्रमौलि: चन्द्रमौलि m. (-लिः) A name of ŚIVA. E. चन्द्र, and मौलि a crest; this deity being represented with a half moon on his forehead.
चन्द्ररेखा: चन्द्ररेखा f. (-खा) A digit of the moon. E. चन्द्र, and रेखा a line.
चन्द्ररेणु: चन्द्ररेणु m. (-णुः) A plagiarist, a poetical thief, (काव्यचौर.) E. चन्द्र the moon, and रेणु dust.
चन्द्रलेखा: चन्द्रलेखा f. (-खा) 1 A plant, (Serrantula anthelmintica:) see सोमराजी. 2 A digit of the moon. E. चन्द्र, and लेखा a line or mark.
चन्द्रलोक: चन्द्रलोक n. (-कं) The sphere or heaven of the moon. E. चन्द्र, and लोक world.
चन्द्रलौह: चन्द्रलौह n. (-हं) Silver. E. चन्द्र, and लौह metal; also चन्द्रलौहकं.
चन्द्रवंश: चन्द्रवंश m. (-शः) The race of the moon, the second great branch of the Kṣatriya or royal dynasties, derived from the moon, through BUDHA his son, and Purūravas his son. E. चन्द्र, and वंश race.
चन्द्रवंशिन्: चन्द्रवंशिन् m. (-शी) A member of the lunar dynasty. E. चन्द्रवंश, and इनि aff.
चन्द्रवल्लरी: चन्द्रवल्लरी f. (-री) 1 A kind of asclepias, (A. acida:) see सोमलता. 2 Rue: see ब्राह्मी. E. चन्द्र the moon, and वल्लरी a creeper.
चन्द्रवाला: चन्द्रवाला f. (-ला) Large cardamoms. E. चन्द्र camphor, and वाला a child, a diminutive term in general.
चन्द्रविहङ्गम: चन्द्रविहङ्गम m. (-मः) A kind of crane. E. चन्द्र the moon, (as white,) and विहङ्गम a bird.
चन्द्रव्रत: चन्द्रव्रत n. (-तं) 1 A regal property or virtue. 2 A kind of penance: see चान्द्रायण. E. चन्द्र the moon, and व्रत religious observance.
चन्द्रशाला: चन्द्रशाला f. (-ला) 1 Moonlight. 2 An upper room, an apartment on the house top. E. चन्द्र the moon, and शाला a hall.
चन्द्रशालिका: चन्द्रशालिका f. (-का) A room on the top of a house. E. कन् affixed to the preceding.
चन्द्रशेखर: चन्द्रशेखर m. (-रः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 The name of a mountain; one so called is amongst the hills of Aracan. E. चन्द्र the moon, and शेखर a crest; whose crest is the moon.
चन्द्रसंज्ञ: चन्द्रसंज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) Camphor. E. चन्द्र, and संज्ञा a name: having all the synonyms of the moon.
चन्द्रसम्भव: चन्द्रसम्भव m. (-वः) Budha, the planet MERCURY. E. चन्द्र, and आत्मज son.
चन्द्रसम्भवा: चन्द्रसम्भवा f. (-वा) Small cardamoms. E. चन्द्र the moon, and सम्भव produced.
चन्द्रसालोक्य: चन्द्रसालोक्य n. (-क्यं) Attainment of the lunar heaven. E. चन्द्र, and सालोक्य domicile.
चन्द्रहास: चन्द्रहास m. (-सः) 1 A scimitar. 2 The sword of RĀVAṆA. f. (-सा) Moon plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) n. (-सं) Silver. E. चन्द्र the moon, and हास what derides; outvieing the moon in brightness.
चन्द्राकृति: चन्द्राकृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Moon-shaped, like the moon, (in roundness, whiteness, &c.) E. चन्द्र, and आकृति form.
चन्द्रातप: चन्द्रातप m. (-पः) 1 Moonlight. 2 An awning. E. चन्द्र the moon, and आतप shining.
चन्द्रार्द्ध: चन्द्रार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) A half moon, a crescent. E. चन्द्र, and अर्द्ध half.
चन्द्रापीड: चन्द्रापीड m. (-डः) A name of ŚIVA. E. चन्द्र the moon, and आपीड a chaplet; who has the moon like a chaplet amidst his hair.
चन्द्राभास: चन्द्राभास m. (-सः) A false moon, an appearance like the moon. E. चन्द्र, and आभास resembling.
चन्द्रिका: चन्द्रिका f. (-का) 1 Moonlight. 2 A small fish, commonly Cāndā, (Canda of var. species, HAM.) 3 Large cardamoms. E. चन्द्र the moon, and वुन् aff.
चन्द्रिकाद्राव: चन्द्रिकाद्राव m. (-वः) The moon-stone. E. चन्द्रिका, and द्राव what fuses; liquefying in moonlight.
चन्द्रिकापायिन्: चन्द्रिकापायिन् m. (-यी) The Cakora or hill partridge. E. चन्द्रिका, and पायिन् who drinks.
चन्द्रिकाम्बुज: चन्द्रिकाम्बुज n. (-जं) The white lotus. E. चन्द्रिका, and अम्बुज a lotus.
चन्द्रिल: चन्द्रिल m. (-लः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A barber. 3 A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) E. चन्द्र the moon or weapon, &c. bright as the moon, and इलच् aff.
चन्द्रोदय: चन्द्रोदय m. (-यः) 1 An awning, a cloth or sheet spread over the large open courts of Hindu houses, upon festival occasions. 2 Moon-rise. 3 A mercurial preparation used in medicine. E. चन्द्र the moon, and उदय rising, (of a planet, &c.)
चन्द्रोपल: चन्द्रोपल m. (-लः) Moon-gem: see चन्द्रकान्त. E. चन्द्र the moon, and उपल a stone.
चप: चप r. 1st cl. (चपति) To caress, to coax, to soothe or console. r. 10th cl. (चपयति) To grind or pound. (इ) चपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (चम्पति चम्पयति) To go, to move.
चपट: चपट m. (-टः) The palm with extended fingers: see चपेट.
चपल: चपल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Trembling, tremulous, shaking. 2 Wavering, unsteady. 3 Inconsiderately criminal. 4 Swift, expeditious; (also in this sense, or swiftly, adv. n. (-लं) 5 Momentary, instantaneous. 6 Agitated violently, overcome with alarm, &c. m. (-लः) 1 Quicksilver. 2 A kind of stone. 3 A fish. 4 A thief. f. (-ला) 1 The goddess LAKṢMĪ or fortune. 2 Lightning. 3 A whore. 4 Long pepper. 5 The tongue. 6 Spirituous liquor. 7 A species of the Aryā metre. E. चप to go, affix अलच्, or चुप to move, Uṇādi affix कल and the radical vowel changed.
चपलता: चपलता f. (-ता) 1 Moving, trembling. 2 Fickleness, inconstancy. E. तल् added to the last, also with त्व, चपलत्वं.
चपलात्मक: चपलात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Of a fickle or inconstant nature. E. चपल, आत्म self, and कन् added.
चपेट: चपेट m. (-टः) The palm of the hand with the fingers extended. E. चप to go, affix अच्, चप trembling, and इट् what goes or is, from इट् with क affix; also चपट and चर्पट.
चपेटाघात: चपेटाघात m. (-तः) A slap with the open hand. E. चपेट, and आघात a blow.
चपेटिका: चपेटिका f. (-का) A slap with the open hand. E. चपेट, and वुन् aff.
चम: चम (उ) चमु r. 1st and 5th cls. (चमति चम्नोति) To eat, to drink, to take any thing into the mouth, as food, whether solid or liquid. With आङ् prefixed, (आचामति) To sip as water. With वि, (विचमति) To eat.
चमत्करण: चमत्करण n. (-णं) 1 Astonishing, producing wonder or surprise. 2 Festival, spectacle. 4 High poetical composition. E. चमत् a sound of surprise, and करण making; also चमत्कार and चमत्कृति.
चमत्कार: चमत्कार m. (-रः) 1 Astonishment, surprise. 2 Show, spectacle. 3 Row, riot, festive or angry turbulence. 4 Elaborate style or high poetical composition. 5 The name of a tree: see अपामार्ग. E. चमत् a sound of surprise, and कार making.
चमत्कारिन्: चमत्कारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Uunsual, surprising, astonishing. E. चमत्कार, and इनि aff.
चमत्कृत: चमत्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Surprised, astonished. E. चमत्, and कृत made.
चमत्कृति: चमत्कृति f. (-तिः) Display, spectacle, &c.: see चमत्करण.
चमर: चमर n. (-रं) 1 A Chowri or long brush, most usually made of the tail-hairs of the Yak or Bos Grunniens, and employed to whisk off insects, flies, &c. 2 The name of a demon. f. (-री) A compound pedicle. mf. (-रः-री) A kind of deer, or rather the Bos Grunniens, erroneously classed by the Hindu writers amongst the deer. E. चम to eat or be eaten, अर aff.
चमरपुच्छ: चमरपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A small animal with a bushy tail; a squirrel. n. (-च्छं) A Chowri. E. चमर, and पुच्छ tail.
चमरिक: चमरिक m. (-कः) A species of ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.) E. चमर a Chowri, and ठक् affix, growing in clusters, resembling a Chowri.
चमस: चमस mf. (-सः-सी) 1 A vessel used at sacrifices for drinking the juice of the acid asclepias, a kind of ladle or spoon. 2 A cake made of barley, rice, or lentils ground to meal. 3 A plant, commonly Khetpāpara, (Mollugo pentaphylla.) 4 A sweetmeat, or flour, sesamum, &c. mixed up with sugar into a kind of cake, &c. E. चम to eat, असच् Uṇādi affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
चमू: चमू f. (-मूः) 1 An army. 2 A squadron, a division of an army consisting of 129 elephants, as many cars, 2187 horse, and 3685 foot. E. चम to eat or destroy, (the enemy,) and ऊ Uṇādi aff.
चमूचर: चमूचर m. (-रः) A soldier, a warrior. E. चमू, and चर who marches.
चमूपति: चमूपति m. (-तिः) A general of division, any general. E. चमू, and पति master.
चमूरु: चमूरु m. (-रुः) A kind of deer. E. चम to be eaten, ऊरच् affix, and उ final added.
चम्प: चम्प r. 1st cl. (-चम्पति) To go or move.
चम्प m. (-म्पः) Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.) f. (-म्पा) The capital of KARṆA, the modern Bhāgalpur, or a place in its vicinity. E. चपि to go, &c., अच् and टाप् affs.
चम्पक: चम्पक m. (-कः) 1 A tree bearing a yellow fragrant flower, (Michelia champaca.) 2 A division of the jack fruit. n. (-कं) The flower of the Campa. 2 A variety of the banana or plantain, (the fruit.) E. चपि to shine, &c. affix वुन्.
चम्पकालु: चम्पकालु (-लुः) The Jāka or Indian bread fruit tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.) E. चम्पक as above, and आलुच् poss. aff.
चम्पकोष: चम्पकोष m. (-षः) The Jāka: see the preceding.
चम्पाधिप: चम्पाधिप m. (-पः) A name of KARṆA. E. चम्पा the city, and अधिप ruler.
चम्पापुरी: चम्पापुरी f. (-री) The city Campā: see चम्पा. E. चम्पा, and पुर a city.
चम्पालु: चम्पालु m. (-लुः) The Jāka: see चम्पकालु. E. चम्प for चम्पक, and आलुच् aff.
चम्पावती: चम्पावती f. (-ती) The district of Campā or Bhāgalpur. E. चम्प the ebony tree, and मतुप् poss. affix, abounding in such trees.
चम्पू: चम्पू f. (-म्पूः) A work in which the same subject is continued through alternations in the composition of prose and verse. E. चम to eat or be eaten, ऊ affix, and प inserted; what is relished by persons of taste.
चम्पेश: चम्पेश m. (-शः) KARṆA the natural brother of the Pāṇḍus. E. चम्पा the city Campā, and ईश sovereign.
चम्पोपलक्षित: चम्पोपलक्षित m. (-तः) The district of Campā or Bhāgalpur, or m. plu. (-ताः) The inhabitants. E. चम्प the ebony, and उपलक्षित designated: see चम्पावती.
चम्ब: चम्ब r. 1st cl. (चम्बति) To go, to move.
चय: चय r. 1st cl. (चयते) To go to or towards, to go, to move.

चय m. (-यः) 1 An assemblage, a multitude. 2 A heap, a collection. 3 A mound of earth, raised to form the foundation of a building. 4 A rampart or mound of earth raised from the ditch of a fort. 5 The gate of a fort. 6 Any edifice. 7 A seat, a stool. 8 A cover, a covering. E. चि to collect, aff. अच्
चयन: चयन n. (-नं) Collecting, gathering. E. चि to collect, ल्युट् aff.
चयनीय: चयनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be collected or gathered. E. चि to collect, अनीयर् aff.
चर: चर r. 1st cl. (चरति) 1 To go. 2 To eat. 3 To behave or act, (in this sense आङ् is usually prefixed;) With अति and आङ् prefixed, To transgress, to go astray. With अभि, 1 To deceive, to betray. 2 To conjure. 3 To attend. With अनु. 1 To follow, to attend. 2 To imitate. With आङ्, 1 To practise a duty. With उत्, (उच्चरते) 1 To transgress. 2 To expel. 3 (उच्चरति) To go up, to rise. With उप, 1 To approach. 2 To worship. With परि, To serve. With प्र, 1 To prevail as a custom. 2 To declare, to manifest. With वि and अभि, To go astray, to act wickedly. With सम् (सञ्चरते) 1 To ride upon. 3 (सञ्चरति) To accompany With सम and आङ्, 1 To perform. 2 To announce. r. 10th cl. (चारयति) 1 To doubt. 2 To be free from doubt. With वि prefixed, To discuss, to dispute, to reason upon or respecting any doubtful points.

चर mfn. (-रः-रा or री-रं) 1 Moveable, locomotive. 2 Trembling, shaking, unsteady. m. (-रः) 1 A spy, a secret emissary or agent. 2 The planet Mars. 3 A game played with dice and men, similar to backgammon. 4 A wagtail. 5 A cowri. 6 The seventh Karaṇa, (in Astrology.) 7 The Karaṇas collectively. f. (-री) A young woman. E. चर to go, affix अच् or टच्, and in the latter case the fem. affix is ङीप्.
चरक: चरक m. (-कः) 1 The author of a treatise upon medicine: applied also to the work. 2 A spy or secret emissary, &c. E. चर to go, Uṇādi affix क्वुन्.
चरट: चरट m. (-टः) A wagtail; also चर.
चरण: चरण mn. (-णः-णं) 1 A foot. 2 The root of a tree. 3 A race, a family. 4 A portion of the Vedas. 5 Fixed or instituted observances. 6 The peculiarity of condition or conduct implied by the English affix hood, as manhood, priesthood, &c. 7 The fourth part of a stanza. 8 (In Prosody,) A dactyl. n. (-णं) 1 Wandering, roaming, going round or about. 2 Eating. E. चर to go, affix ल्युट्.
चरणकिशलय: चरणकिशलय n. (-यं) The foot of a lover, a deity, &c. E. चरण, and किशलय lotus filament.
चरणगत: चरणगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fallen at one's feet, prostrate. E. चरण, and गत gone.
चरणग्रन्थि: चरणग्रन्थि f. (-न्थिः) The ancle. E. चरण the foot, and ग्रन्थि a joint.
चरणपतन: चरणपतन n. (-नं) Prostration, falling at the feet. E. चरण, and पतन falling.
चरणपतित: चरणपतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Prostrate, fallen at the feet. E. चरण, and पतित fallen.
चरणपात: चरणपात m. (-तः) Tread, trampling, foot-fall. E. चरण, and पात falling.
चरणयुग: चरणयुग m. (-गं) 1 Both the feet. 2 Two lines of a stanza. E. चरण, and युग a pair.
चरणसेवा: चरणसेवा f. (-बा) Service, devotion. E. चरण, and सेवा service.
चरणार्द्ध: चरणार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) 1 The half of the foot. 2 Half of the fourth of a stanza. E. चरण, and अर्द्ध half.
चरणानमित: चरणानमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Trodden down, bent or bowed under the feet. E. चरण, and आनमित bowed.
चरणाभरण: चरणाभरण n. (-णं) An ornament on the feet. E. चरण, and आभरण ornament.
चरणामृत: चरणामृत n. (-तं) The water in which the feet of a venerable Brahman or teacher have been washed. E. चरण, and अमृत nectar.
चरणायुध: चरणायुध m. (-धः) A cock. E. चरण the foot, and आयुध a weapon, whose foot is his weapon.
चरणारविन्द: चरणारविन्द n. (-न्दं) The foot (of a deity, a lover, &c.) E. चरण, and अरविन्द a lotus; also many similar compounds, as चरणपद्मं, चरणकमल, चरणनलिनं, &c.
चरणास्कन्दन: चरणास्कन्दन n. (-नं) Trampling, treading on. E. चरण, and आस्कन्दन going.
चरणोदक: चरणोदक n. (-कं) Water in which the feet of a venerable Brahman or spiritual teacher have been washed. E. चरण, and उदक water.
चरणोपग: चरणोपग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) In contact with the feet, at the feet. E. चरण, and उपग approached.
चरत्: चरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Going, going to. E. चर to go, शतृ aff.
चरम: चरम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Last, ultimate, final. 2 West, western. चर to go, अम Uṇādi aff.
चरमक्ष्माभृत्: चरमक्ष्माभृत् m. (-भृत्) The western mountain behind which the sun is supposed to set. E. चरम western, and क्ष्माभृत् a mountain; also चरमाचल, &c.
चरमाद्रि: चरमाद्रि m. (-द्रिः) See चरमक्ष्माभृत्; also other similar compounds.
चराचर: चराचर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Moveable, locomotive. 2 Shaking, trembling, unsteady. 3 Wished, desired. 4 Moveable and immoveable. n. (-रं) 1 The world. 2 Sky, atmosphere. 3 Heaven, paradise. 4 The aggregate of all things, whether inanimate or animate. E. चर to go, affix अच, and the derivative reiterated, आङ् inserted; or चर what goes, and अचर what does not go.
चरि: चरि m. (-रिः) An animal in general. E. चर locomotive, and इ Uṇādi aff.
चरित: चरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone, gone to, attained. n. (-तं) Fixed institute, proper or peculiar observance: see चरण. 2 Story, adventures. 3 Practice, behaviour. 4 Nature. E. चर to go, affix क्त.
चरितव्य: चरितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be followed or observed. E. चर, and तव्य aff.
चरितार्थ: चरितार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Effected, accomplished. 2 Successful. E. चरित, and अर्थ object.
चरितगुणत्व: चरितगुणत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Accompaniment, assistance. 2 Meritorious conduct. E. चरित, and गुणत्व faculty.
चरित्र: चरित्र n. (-त्रं) 1 Instituted and peculiar observance or conduct. 2 Story, adventures. 3 Practice, habit, behaviour. 4 Nature, disposition. f. (-त्रा) The tamarind tree. E. चर to go, इत्र Uṇādi aff.
चरित्रबन्धक: चरित्रबन्धक n. (-कं) A friendly pledge, one of unequal value to the loan. E. चरित्र, and बन्धक a pledge.
चरिष्णु: चरिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Moveable, locomotive. 2 Wandering about. E. चर to go, and इष्णुच् aff.
चरीत्र: चरीत्र n. (-त्रं) Practice, conduct, behaviour: see चरित्र.
चरु: चरु m. (-रुः) 1 An oblation of rice, barley, and pulse, boiled with butter and milk for presentation to the gods or manes. 2 The vessel in which such an oblation is prepared. E. चर to eat, उण् Uṇādi affix, what the gods feed upon.
चरुव्रण: चरुव्रण m. (-णः) A kind of cake. E. चर to eat, उ affix, edible, and व्रण what is ground or pounded.
चरुश्रपण: चरुश्रपण n. (-णं) Sprinkling an oblation of milk and ghee. E. चरु and श्रपण scattering.
चरुस्थाली: चरुस्थाली f. (-ला) The vessel in which an oblation is prepared. E. चरु, and स्थाली a pot.
चर्घ: चर्घ r. 1st cl. (चर्घत्ति) To go or move.
चर्च: चर्च r. 1st and 6th cls. (चर्चति) 1 To speak or say. 2 To abuse, to reprove, to censure or condemn. 3 To injure or hurt. 4 To inquire. r. 10th cl. (चर्चयति) To read over, to peruse carefully, to study; also read चर्च्च.
चर्च्च r. 1st and 10th cls. (चर्च्चते चर्च्चयते) 1 To speak, to tell. 2 To reprove. 3 To study: see चर्च.
चर्चरी: चर्चरी f. (-री) 1 A festival, festive sport. 2 A kind of song. 3 Striking the hands to beat time. 4 Curled or woolly hair. 5 Musical symphony or, the recitation of scholars. 6 The noise made at festivals, &c. 7 Flattery, dishonest praise. चर्चरीक: चर्चरीक m. (-कः) 1 A form of ŚIVA. 2 A potherb. 3 Decorating or curling the hair. E. चर्चरी noise, &c. and क who utters, from कै to sound, affix ड; some authorities substitute बर्चरीक for this word.
चर्चा: चर्चा f. (-चा) 1 Reflexion, consideration, the exercise of judgment or deliberation. 2 Cleaning the person with fragrant unguents. 3 Inquiry, investigation. 4 A name of the goddess DURGĀ. E. चर्च to read, &c. affixes अङ् and टाप्; also चर्चिका, &c.
चर्चिका: चर्चिका f. (-का) 1 The goddess DURGĀ or CĀMUṆḌĀ. 2 Cleaning the person with perfumes. 3 Deliberation, inquiry. E. चर्च to ask, affix ण्वुल्; also चर्चा as above.
चर्चित: चर्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Perfumed, anointed, smeared with sandal, &c. 2 Sought, desired. 3 Inquired into or after, investigated. E. चर्चा smearing, &c. and इतच् aff.
चर्च्च: चर्च्च r. 1st and 10th cls. (चर्च्चते चर्च्चयते) 1 To speak, to tell. 2 To reprove. 3 To study: see चर्च.

चर्पट: चर्पट m. (-टः) 1 The open palm of the hand with fingers extended. 2 A plant, (Mollugo pentaphylla.) 3 A quantity of bubbles or specks, (स्फारविपुल.) f. (-टी) A thin cake or biscuit of flour. E. चर्प a Sautra root, to be low or flat, affix अटच्; also चपट and चपेट.
